g.title: W3
g.text: Samtec FFSD-20-D 1.27 mm IDC ribbon, 28 AWG

28 AWG derated 0.25 A (SQSO-HAR-001 5.2): 3V3_OBC 0.088 A per wire at the SW10 trip (35 %); VBAT_MTQ 0.115 A per wire with all three H-bridges at their current limit (46 %). AGND joins GND at one point on the EPS. Every OBC output is high-impedance at OBC reset and held low by 100 k on the EPS. EOL_ARM and EOL_FIRE sit on different MCU ports (F, G) and different cable rows

g.title: J_OBC
g.text: OBC board J1 (STM32L4R5ZIT6 pins as labelled)
